rationale: MFI/non-bank lender register is a section of cbcg.me already covered by monitoring the CBCG parent, but worth mining for the non-bank credit tier.
CRTR central account register is a standalone, continuously updated payments dataset distinct from generic CBCG news.
Periodic PDF/Excel enforcement-blocked-accounts releases form a longitudinal machine-readable credit-distress series.
Credit-registry service page is a CBCG sub-page and the URL failed verification; recheck liveness before separate tracking.
CRPS national company register is the authoritative entity-resolution join key for banks, PSPs and agents.
Modern Tax Administration IRMS front end to registry data, likely structured endpoints and the successor to legacy CRPS.
UBO register is high value for AML ownership tracing but URL failed and access conditions are unclear; recheck.
Official gazette is the definitive dated source for laws, CBCG decisions and entry-into-force deadlines — core to A3.
Central e-participation archive is the canonical index of consultation windows and draft-law deadlines.
gov.me ministry news is the first-publication channel for consultation calls with a stable crawlable URL pattern.
Insurance supervisor runs its own registers and consultation deadlines in parallel to CBCG; bancassurance-adjacent and in scope.
Pledge register is a standalone judicial-branch dataset mapping secured lending by bank and MFI.
Bailiff directory is a mine-once lead list; the propisi section is only weakly regulation-generating for banking/payments.
Wayback is the archival backstop for frequently reorganised Montenegrin regulator sites and enables point-in-time register diffing.
A single mirrored gazette PDF — useful fallback evidence, not a monitored signal producer.
Unofficial commercial mirror of CRPS data, low credibility and redundant against the official register.
MONEYVAL country page publishes dated AML evaluation and follow-up obligations that drive Montenegrin bank/PSP deadlines.
FATF country hub mirrors MER/FUR in stable PDF form with rating tables; partially redundant with MONEYVAL but machine-fetchable.
IMF country page yields annual Article IV assessments of banking supervision and SEPA integration; failed URL is a soft signal only.
A single 2016 FSAP technical note — anchor evidence document, not a recurring source; URL needs recheck.
Annual EC enlargement report is effectively an English forward regulatory calendar for financial-services acquis alignment.
Single communication page under the enlargement portal already covered by the country hub.
ECB international-cooperation MoU register signals changes in consolidated supervision reaching EU-parent Montenegrin subsidiaries.
EBA equivalence/international-cooperation hub gates supervisory-college participation and cross-border data flows for CBCG.
EPC sets binding SEPA adherence dates and versioned country lists — a core payments-deadline source for Montenegrin PSPs.
BIS CPMI stats are methodological and comparative only; Montenegro is not in the Red Book series, so country value is thin.
Semi-annual World Bank regional report with a Montenegro financial-sector note; recurring and English-language.
